summary: Iteration 2 — Nursing Library module (backend + frontend). All 15 new backend library tests PASS (100% — total suite now 26+15=41). Verified: 26 categories with book_count, book listing + category/q filter, featured (featured/recent/continue_reading/bookmarked), book detail with TOC-only chapters (no content leak), chapter fetch with notes+is_bookmarked and reading-progress update, bookmark toggle idempotency, notes create+delete flow, library full-text search (heparin returns book+chapter hits with snippet), admin RBAC (403 for non-admin on POST/PUT/DELETE), admin create-and-delete book flow with chapter_count/page_count auto-calc, regular signup does NOT get is_admin=true, AI /api/ai/chat SSE emits 'references' event BEFORE 'done' for 'Explain heparin monitoring' with book_id/chapter/book_title/author/chapter_title fields and persists references on assistant message. Frontend UI verified end-to-end via Playwright mobile viewport (390x844): demo login → /library shows 26 category cards + Featured/Recent horizontal rows + search box (lib-admin-btn correctly hidden for non-admin) → Pharmacology category → book detail (Read Now, TOC, bookmark) → reader (prev/next, TOC modal opens 4 chapters, font-, font+, add-note, ask-ai, bookmark, in-book search all present) → /library/search with 'heparin' returns 2 books + hits.

ui_bugs.issue: Console error observed while rendering chapter body: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' — likely a stray whitespace between two JSX elements inside a <View> (candidates: the header row in read/[bookId].tsx around iconBtn siblings, or the chapters mapping in book/[id].tsx). Not a red screen, but should be cleaned up.

issues: Category grid uses width: '31.7%' with margin:4 — visually fine on 390px viewport, but on narrower screens (<360px) 3 columns may wrap oddly. Consider fixed columnCount via width: '32%' or flex-basis. Category card colors are provided in seed but ensure white text on lighter category.color values keeps AA contrast (some seed colors may be too light for #FFF).

action_items: (LOW) Investigate & fix 'Unexpected text node' React Native warning triggered on reader/book-detail screens. Look for whitespace/newlines directly inside <View> tags (usually between mapped children or between conditional blocks and closing tags).
(Optional) Consider CDN thumbnail sizing for book covers — expo-image on web downloads full-resolution unsplash images; provide ?w=200 querystring on cover_image for faster horizontal-row rendering.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1051 lines — well past the 700-line soft cap. Recommend splitting into routers: auth.py, study.py, questions.py, exams.py, abroad.py, passport.py, cme.py, jobs_news.py, notifications.py, ai.py, library.py, library_admin.py. Also move _library_matches + LIB_INDEX into library.py.

library_data.py chapter content is stored embedded on book documents. For future scaling, consider a separate lib_chapters collection with an index on (book_id, number). Currently every /library/books/{id} fetch pulls all chapter bodies from Mongo just to build TOC — _book_detail should project chapters to {number,title} only.
@app.on_event startup remains — still deprecated (already flagged in iteration_1). Bootstrapping the library at startup makes migration to lifespan more important now.
admin_edit_book uses body.dict() (Pydantic v1 style) — on Pydantic v2 body.model_dump() is preferred (v1 dict() still works via warning).

library_search does substring search with .lower() on every chapter for every request; for 17 books this is fine but O(N * chapters) — plan to move to Mongo text index or the LIB_INDEX already built via build_search_index.
